decisions.reason: As a newly launched naval lighting system in a specialist segment the firm already serves, the high development and certification effort and the public launch make management inclined to continue rather than reverse course quickly.

The desk lamp is somewhat less central to the firm's stated move toward intelligent building-wide solutions, but its own product page and ergonomic positioning still create enough commitment for management to give it more time.

This general interior luminaire sits at the core of the firm's mainstream application portfolio and was explicitly introduced as new, so sunk development costs and strong strategic fit make withdrawal unlikely.

A pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics fits the firm's office and institutional lighting business, and even with only modest website prominence management would usually persist after a recent launch.

The marine HMI searchlight is niche and less aligned with the firm's sustainability direction than its interior LED offerings, but specialist-market investment and the tendency to justify recent launches still favor retention for now.

This marine searchlight matches the firm's robust specialist-lighting capability, and a large German manufacturer with recent launch costs and public commitment would typically keep it on the market longer before reconsidering.
